description: This file provides database connection handling and query execution functions for a PostgreSQL database, including configuration from environment variables and connection creation using the psycopg library.

classes.name: DatabaseSettings
classes.description: Dataclass encapsulating the database connection URL settings, resolved from environment variables.

methods.name: str _build_postgres_url_from_env()
methods.description: Constructs a PostgreSQL connection URL from environment variables, raising an error if required variables are missing.

methods.name: DatabaseSettings get_db_settings()
methods.description: Returns database settings as a DatabaseSettings object, resolving from environment variables.

methods.name: psycopg.Connection get_connection()
methods.description: Creates and returns a new psycopg database connection using the configured URL.

methods.name: Optional[dict] fetch_one(conn: psycopg.Connection, query: str, params: Optional[dict] = None)
methods.description: Executes a query and returns the first row as a dict, or None if no result.

methods.name: list[dict] fetch_all(conn: psycopg.Connection, query: str, params: Optional[dict] = None)
methods.description: Executes a query and returns all rows as a list of dicts.

methods.name: int execute(conn: psycopg.Connection, query: str, params: Optional[dict] = None)
methods.description: Executes a query (such as an UPDATE or INSERT) and returns the number of affected rows.

ctags.name: execute
ctags.pattern: /^def execute(conn: psycopg.Connection, query: str, params: Optional[dict] = None) -> int:$/
ctags.signature: (conn: psycopg.Connection, query: str, params: Optional[dict] = None)

ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_all(conn: psycopg.Connection, query: str, params: Optional[dict] = None) -> list[dict]/
ctags.signature: (conn: psycopg.Connection, query: str, params: Optional[dict] = None)
